column2: Right!
Isn't there some way to save Utsugi-san...?
Utsugi-san... is there no way to save you...? Can you never come back to the human world? Leaving your sister Saori-san behind...
Saori... my sister...
{!R}!? Utsugi-san!! {!R}He's still conscious inside the ice!! {!R}That's right, Utsugi-san!\n\n{!R}Are you going to erase your sister from this world too!?
Why is a machine like this here... Who brought it in?
Could this be...?
The remains of the "Ma."
Dr. Kuruma!? What on earth are you doing here?
Isn't it obvious! You saw it too, the terror of the "Ma"! Its practically inexhaustible power!
Look at this body! This magnificent body!! I'll build the "Ma" into this body! And be reborn as a more evolved human!
I can't go along with your ideas...
That's only because you can't understand them.
Well, never mind. You'll understand in time. Once you see me with the "Ma" built in...
Why are you doing this research? Even sacrificing Shinichi-kun... your own child...
When the environment is polluted and changes, any living thing will die out. Mankind already has that day right before its eyes...
Environmental pollution...
We must create living things that can survive in a new age. A new humanity that can endure a terrible hell and lead us into that age... No good...!
Not enough samples...\n\nI need living "Ma," or black fiends...
The black fiends are after you.\n\nIf I fight to protect you, I'll get countless samples! I'll keep you safe until I've collected all the samples I need. What do you say?
A good choice! Then let's go!
Just a child after all. Seems you can't weigh the profit and loss of this deal... You're in the way of my research. If you've no business here, get out!
Hmph, changed your mind and decided to accept my offer?
Old man!
Dr. Kuruma!?
So you're alive, Shinichi... What became of that little girl?
Maria is...
Maria is inside me!
Wahahahaha! I see, I see! Shinichi, you've taken Maria into yourself? Going that far for power... That's my son!
What did you say!?
Dr. Kuruma, what on earth are you doing here?
We must create living things that can survive in a new age. A new humanity that can endure a terrible hell and lead us into that age...
Don't talk such nonsense!!
So you still don't understand...
Don't screw with me!!
Silence, Shinichi!! I'm not asking you. Well, {p}?
{p}!? Why!!
Right now we need all the strength we can get.\n\nIf he's willing to help, this is better...
A leopard, here...? Poor thing... It's covered in wounds.
It ran off... It seemed really frightened...
Where'd that woman hide?
Bossing us around all this time!
Let's send that woman to the Demon King! As a servant!
Hey! Isn't this the kid everybody's talking about!?
It is! Now that's a lucky find!
The Demon King'll be happier with this kid than with Sister Jill!
Those guys were picking on this leopard...
So Sister Jill was a leopard all along...
Uhh... nnn... Huh!?
You're the brat who was with Honey Kisaragi!? What did you do to my underlings!?
To your underlings? What are you talking about?
Playing dumb!? You controlled my underlings and made them attack me!
I don't know anything about it!\n\nWeren't they being controlled by black fiends?
Black fiends?\n\nDon't think you can fool me!
That's not it! Listen to me!
What! So that's what's been happening... An enemy who can toy with Panther Claw's members... a fearsome foe...
Foe?
It controlled Panther Claw's members and had them attack me, Sister Jill-sama! To me, the black fiends are the enemy!\n\nI have my pride as head of Panther Claw's Japan branch!
What are you going to do?
Isn't it obvious! Fight the Demon King! I'm going with you! I see that as the shortcut to the Demon King! Any objections?
Good! A wise choice, little boy.\n\nTee-hee... If I team up with him, then that beautiful Honey...
Huh? Did you say something?
N-nothing at all!\n\nCome on, don't dawdle! Let's go!
I see. Then I'll fight the Demon King alone! We'll meet again!
Look! A leopard! What's it doing here...
Poor thing... It's covered in wounds.
It ran off... It seemed really frightened...
Somebody must have been picking on it...
Those guys were picking on this leopard...
Uhh... nnn... Huh!?
Honey!?
Sister Jill... So your true form was a leopard...
So you've seen it... But this is no time for that! What did you do to my underlings!?
To your underlings? What are you talking about?
Playing dumb!? You controlled my underlings and made them attack me!
Your own underlings attacked you? You reap what you sow!
How rude!
Now, now...
Now, now...\n\n...Could your underlings have been controlled by black fiends?
Black fiends?\n\nDon't think you can fool me!
That's not it! Listen to me!
What! So that's what's been happening... An enemy who can toy with Panther Claw's members... a fearsome foe...
Foe?
It controlled Panther Claw's members and had them attack me, Sister Jill-sama! To me, the black fiends are the enemy!\n\nI have my pride as head of Panther Claw's Japan branch!
So... what are you going to do?
Isn't it obvious! Fight the Demon King! I'm going with you!
Hey, cut it out!
There's no need to hate it so much! You'll make your big sister sad.
Ahem! Er, anyway...! I see it as the shortcut to the Demon King! Any objections?
What a selfish woman!\n\nYou killed Honey's papa...!!
Because he wouldn't hand over the Airborne Element Fixer like a good boy!
What did you say!?
Sister Jill, I hate you! ...But now is no time to fight with you.
Exactly. If we don't defeat the Demon King, the world faces disaster...
If we defeat the Demon King...\n\nthen I'll defeat you with the same sword that pierced him!
Just what I want...!\n\nGood, then let's go! Don't dawdle!
